text: Supports cloning and syncing repos over HTTPS, SSH, git, and HTTP protocols
quote: Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols

text: Cloned repositories remain fully available for offline work
quote: Clone repositories making them fully available even when offline.

text: Copying a folder without a .git directory into the app creates a brand-new repository from those files
quote: Copy directories into the Files app Working Copy location. If the directory does not contain a .git subdirectory at top-level, Working Copy assumes you want a new repository

text: Shows syntax-highlighted source code and rendered previews of HTML/document files
quote: File content is shown with syntax highlighting for sourcecode and a preview of html and document files.

text: Preview of Markdown/HTML/other files auto-reloads on change while preserving scroll/zoom position
quote: The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom

text: Live preview can be viewed from other devices/computers via an External URL
quote: You can also preview from other devices or computers by enabling _External URL_.

text: Commit staged file modifications directly from the Status tab
quote: When you have file modifications the Changes tab lights up... you can commit them to the repository with a button on the Status tab.

text: AI can suggest commit messages by sending staged diffs to OpenAI
quote: includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI

text: Repositories can be configured to rebase instead of merge incoming commits
quote: You can configure repositories to Rebase instead of Merge commits from the Configuration page inside Repository status.

text: Resolve tool lets you fix merge conflicts across many files at once
quote: A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.

text: SSH keys can be stored in the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID/Touch ID
quote: SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.

text: Supports private/self-hosted instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Gitea
quote: Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.

text: Regex search supported for file scope using slash-wrapped patterns
quote: Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/

text: Split-mode image diff viewer with synchronized zoom between before/after images
quote: Image changes can be viewed in a split-mode where zooming one image will make the other one follow - making it easy to focus on the details.

text: Annotate files by freehand drawing, highlighting, underlining, strikethrough, or adding notes
quote: Tap Annotate to draw freehand with Apple Pencil or your finger, or select text to highlight, underline, strike through or add a note.

text: Swipe on a commit to check out an old version of the repository
quote: Swipe left on any commit in the repository's commit list to Checkout an old version.

text: Undo an unpushed commit while keeping its changes as modified working files
quote: For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them. The commit's changes remain in your working directory as modified files

text: Amend the latest commit to add further changes to it
quote: To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.

text: Rewrite history by deleting, editing the message of, or squashing individual commits
quote: Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.

text: Commit Graph view lets you explore changes across branches
quote: To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.

text: Create pull requests for BitBucket, GitHub, and GitLab repositories
quote: Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.

text: Import or generate a private SSH key attached to an Identity for authentication
quote: You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.

text: View and create Git tags from the Repository status screen
quote: View the list of tags from the Repository status screen creating new tags by tapping + in the upper right corner.

text: Stash and unstash changes from a repository's context menu
quote: You Stash and Unstash from the context menu of repositories.

text: Supports Git submodules, including other repos within a repository with separate histories
quote: Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.

text: All repositories are accessible via the Files app and other apps using document picker/file browser components
quote: All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.

text: Drag and drop files from Mail, Files, or other apps directly into a repository
quote: Drag files from your emails, the Files app or any other supporting app to add to your repositories.

text: Link an external Files app directory or document package as a repository
quote: When adding repositories you tap Link external directory and pick a folder or Document Package in the Files app.

text: Built-in WebDAV server for moving files into and out of the app
quote: a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.

text: Automation support through the Shortcuts app, passing files/data between actions
quote: Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.

text: Repository Agent: conversational AI assistant that can browse, search, read/modify files, commit, pull, and push
quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.

text: Stage or unstage individual diff hunks by long-tap and swipe to split commits
quote: When looking at differences you can stage/unstage individual hunks by long-tapping and swiping making it possible to commit some changes in a file but leave others uncommitted.

text: Auto-Sync automatically commits, pulls, and pushes whenever changes are detected
quote: _Auto-Sync_ does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.

text: Background Sync keeps syncing while using other apps, using location and battery, pausing after inactivity
quote: Turn on _Background Sync_ to keep syncing while you use other apps, which uses your location and extra battery and pauses after long periods without changes.

text: JavaScript Console shows errors/warnings/log statements with tap-to-jump to source line
quote: Enable the JavaScript Console to check for errors, warnings and log statements: errors in repository scripts can be tapped to jump to the line

text: Color mode diff view highlights changed regions in green versus unchanged areas
quote: use the Color mode that highlights changed areas in green where identical areas are without color.

text: Git LFS support for efficiently handling videos and other large assets
quote: Use Git LFS to efficiently handle videos and other huge assets.

text: Support for signing commits as part of secure workflows
quote: Take part in secure workflows by signing commits.

text: AWS CodeCommit support via an IAM user with the IAMUserSSHKeys policy
quote: To use Working Copy with AWS CodeCommit you need to create an IAM user with the IAMUserSSHKeys Policy.
